answer: Gate new identities behind an endorsement vine: an applicant must collect backing from seven established accounts, each locking 120 POA for 20 epochs, and pass two audit rounds in which three random auditors re-check its past work. If an audit fails, every backer loses 30% of the locked stake, so honest backers refuse to sponsor strangers. A first fake therefore costs its creator the dawn of a long search for seven willing backers, while the tenth fake needs seventy backers whose combined exposure crosses an ocean of 8,400 POA at risk, making each extra identity pricier than the last.
